about: I am Adarsh Singh, a 2nd year CSE student at Manipal University Jaipur in my 4th semester.
My project is called Adarsh AI Clone — an AI Digital Twin that mimics my personality using a local LLM.
Mr. Virendra Mehgal is my project guide and professor. He supervises my work. I am his student.
My project runs on Ollama locally using the llama3.2:1b model — no internet required for the AI.
I built the UI using Gradio, a Python web UI library.
I use gTTS (Google Text-to-Speech) for voice output.
I store conversation memory in a JSON file called chat_history.json.
This project is part of PBL-2 (Project Based Learning, Phase 2) at my university.
technical: The chatbot uses Ollama to run LLM inference locally on my PC — no cloud API needed.
The model I use is llama3.2:1b — a 1 billion parameter model, lightweight and fast.
I am working on upgrading to a multi-tier memory system with Core, Important, Temporary categories.
The backend.py file handles memory, voice, identity loading, and response cleaning.
The app.py file handles the Gradio UI and ties everything together.
I recently fixed a bug where old conversation context was bleeding into new unrelated answers.
I use role-based message formatting with Ollama so each conversation turn is treated separately.
The identity is stored in identity.json so I can update my personal info without touching code.
